IANA timezone for estimate/date displays (e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago) — blank uses the viewer's local zone.

patch({ custom_statuses: value })} textarea wide /> patch({ status_transitions: value })} textarea wide />

Custom estimate statuses: a JSON list of slugs, e.g. {'["on_hold","awaiting_permit"]'}, plus a transitions map {'{"on_hold":["sent","cancelled"]}'}. Custom statuses get no outgoing moves until the map allows them.
